name: taco bell dry storage
description: the back-of-house warehouse alcove: metal shelving rows loaded with boxes of soft tortillas, paper cups, sauce bags, and a mountain of takeout bags in gallon zip bags. a pallet jack idles against the far wall under a single bulb. stacked next to the door is a dormant mountain of cleaned, utterably identical cardboard boxes one tall person could never reach on purpose. it smells of cardboard, dust, and the faint sweetness of old flour.

environment.noise: bulb hum, box shift, far compressor

items.name: storage shelves
items.description: metal shelving loaded to the top with dry-stock: boxes of soft flour tortillas, bags of shells, sauce bags, napkin packs, and a leaning pile of glove boxes.

items.name: hardware cart
items.description: a service cart with a broom, mop head, a pair of cleaning spray bottles, and a pink 3M glove someone left stretched on a wheel.

items.name: pallet jack
items.description: a forgotten pallet jack parked by the far wall, hydraulic handle down, skid until it is needed. the warning sticker has worn to just the word 'CAUTION' in red.
